title: The Cup of the Wine of Wrath
description: The Lord commands Jeremiah to take the cup of the wine of wrath from his hand and give it to all the nations to drink. The prophet lists the nations that will be struck, from Jerusalem and Judah to Egypt, the cities of the Philistines, Edom, Moab, Ammon, Tyre, Sidon, the kings of Arabia, Elam, Media, and the kings of the north, and finally the king of Sheshach. All shall drink, stagger, and fall by the sword, and none may refuse to take the cup.
